verdict: Nvidia's revenue jumped 62% to a record $57.0B as Data Center sales hit $51.2B, and it kept $31.9B of that as profit.

segments.name: Data Center
segments.note: AI data-center platforms; a record $51.2B, up 66% YoY and 90% of total revenue. Within it, compute was $43.0B (+56%) and networking a record $8.2B (+162%) on NVLink fabric for GB200 and GB300 systems.

segments.name: Edge Computing
segments.note: Gaming ($4.3B, +30%), professional visualization ($760M, +56%), automotive ($592M) and OEM and other ($174M); up 34% YoY in total.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: R&D spending on new chips and platforms like Vera Rubin; up 39% YoY as Nvidia hires and builds faster.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Sales and admin costs; up 26% YoY, growing far slower than revenue.

otherDetail: Interest income of $624M, plus $1,363M of other income — mostly $1,354M of gains on stakes Nvidia holds in other companies — less $61M of interest expense.
follow100Note: The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Data Center is nearly the whole company
takeaways.text: Data Center revenue was a record $51.2B — 90 cents of every revenue dollar. Compute brought in $43.0B (+56%) and networking a record $8.2B (+162%) as NVLink fabrics for GB200/GB300 systems ramped.

takeaways.title: Cash kept pouring in
takeaways.text: Operating cash flow was $23.8B in the quarter. Nvidia returned $12.7B to shareholders ($12.5B of buybacks plus dividends) and still had $62.2B of buyback authorization left.

takeaways.title: Guidance points higher still
takeaways.text: Nvidia guided fourth-quarter revenue to $65.0B, plus or minus 2%, with gross margin around 74.8% — another step up from this quarter's record.

oneTimers: Gains from non-marketable and publicly-held equity securities of $1,354M sit inside GAAP other income and are excluded from non-GAAP results. GAAP and non-GAAP net income were nearly identical this quarter ($31,910M vs $31,767M).
